reason: Tuesday is dead and ₹1,500 is less than I lose on one empty Tuesday, so the maths is not the question. What gets me over the line is that nobody's money goes through the app and entry stays at my counter in my name, the way I already take it.
objection: My staff will not learn new software. If running the bracket lands on whoever is behind the counter on a Tuesday, it gets opened twice and then never again, and I am paying for a screen nobody switches on.
would_change_my_mind: If I find out players can stake or pay anything inside the app, or that it quietly handles money at some point, I cancel the same day — I have been burned by a real-money app once and I watched the 2025 ban take people out.
